mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sys_user WHERE username = #{username} AND deleted = 0
SELECT * FROM sys_user WHERE LOWER(email) = LOWER(#{email}) AND deleted = 0

SELECT u.id, u.username, u.nickname, u.avatar, r.role_code AS roleCode FROM sys_user u JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE u.family_id = #{familyId} AND u.deleted = 0 AND ur.family_id = #{familyId} AND r.status = 1 ORDER BY u.id
